name: Spartan Livegames Dragon Tiger
decisions: Dragon Tiger is the first production vertical slice.
Game truth and dealer presentation remain separate.
Round progression uses a guarded deterministic state machine.
Baccarat and Roulette remain unavailable until their routes exist.
issues: RNG and settlement are client-side demo logic and are not production-authoritative.
Real-device iPhone Safari QA is still required.
lessons: Dealer media must follow round state; it must never determine round state.
Both card reveals require explicit state transitions rather than one generic dealing flag.
